title: Preserve profile settings when validation fails

clarifications.invalid_input: Both username and profile tagline are required. Invalid changes must not persist. The user can correct an invalid edit and save in the same session.
clarifications.scope: Preserve existing username format and uniqueness checks; do not change registration or OAuth.

source_inspiration.note: Curated injected regression in the MIT-licensed LiveBeats demo, not a claimed historical upstream bug. Historical dependency pin avoids later ML model downloads.
